metadata.description: runward — the deterministic, zero-LLM conformance gate for agentic delivery. Install the gate at your agent's turn end.

plugins.name: runward-gate
plugins.description: Runs runward check --strict when the agent finishes a turn (Stop hook, advisory) and orients the agent in a runward-governed repo. The deterministic gate — it verifies traced decisions and their evidence. The hard governance gate is CI (stranxik/runward as a required check). Requires a runward/ mission (npx runward init).
